claim: Declaring a narrator reserves mix headroom for voice-over before a single line is written, and tells the edit that shots must breathe under speech instead of cutting on the action. A diary and an omniscient VO are different contracts with the audience about who is telling this and how much they know.
not_visual: none, char_vo and omniscient_vo are pure audio and change nothing in a frame. The text-bearing options (text_card, diary, letter) are composited insert graphics inserted between shots, not a treatment of the subject panel — and Animagine cannot render legible text, so those panels would show typographic noise rather than the option.
